player_prompt.intro:
I ye Jwé {player_id} ({piece}). Jwé mɛnɛmɛnɛ ni ({opp}).
Kɛlɛw bɛɛ kɔ kɛ '[a2 a3]' (tɛmɛn → tɛmɛnna).
- Kɛlɛ kɔɔnin bɛɛ kɔ kɛ sɔrɔ dɔɔnin tɛmɛn kan.
- Kɛlɛ dabɔ bɛɛ kɔ kɛ sɔrɔ dɔɔnin jɛgɛnw kan.
Kɛlɛ dabɔ kɔɔnɛ bɛɛ {score_per_capture} pɔti.
Jwé bɛɛ kɔ kɛ {max_moves} kɛlɛw kɔɔnɛ tɛmɛnna.
